stage: pnpm data:midtown (also run by pnpm data:city and pnpm data)

inputs.brookwood: pipeline/prototypes/square-board/brookwood-{south,station} from 8678645f; ground.json records the USGS 3DEP tile URLs and hashes.
inputs.r16: OSM archive and baker from 9803080e, with the verified raw R16 context from 8474a103 and DEM packet from e2058adc. Supply x74y374.tif and x74y375.tif from the URLs in square-board/r16/ground.json.
inputs.golf: OSM course extract and registered features from private checkpoint 8474a103 under private-checkpoint/ansley/source; the imported ansley-mounted-source.json records ODbL attribution, geographic projection and raw map digest.
inputs.canopy: City of Atlanta and Georgia Tech 2023 Urban Tree Canopy. UTCMosaic2023.tif from https://cura.design.gatech.edu/UTC/UTCMosaic2023.zip. R16 runs the standard City canopy bake (bake_r16.py) with course, parking, water, rail, highway-sightline, trail and portal exclusions; crown heights read the Meta & WRI canopy height map (Tolan et al., 2024, CC BY 4.0). The TIFF and height-crop SHA-256s and the R16 population are in r16-canopy-audit.json. Brookwood uses the canonical midtown-landscape crown selection with course exclusions.
inputs.exclusions: highway-four/east-ways.json, northeast-trail/axis.json and norcross-north-study.json from 74e0f9f0; nr-path.json from the Rail R16 burial study.
inputs.packedContexts: d3f24dfc, integrated as 4d6509da. hashes.json identifies the plain source and final uncompressed context bytes. rows.sha256.json from 8474a103 covers the mounted context and both terrain files for each northern row.
